title: American Hiker Accidentally Impales Himself and Walks 16 km for Help
description: An American hiker, impaled by his own trekking pole, managed to walk 16 kilometers before being rescued in Montana.

sections.heading: The Incident
paragraphs: According to Sud Ouest, an American hiker was accidentally impaled by his own trekking pole while hiking in Montana. Despite the severe injury, he was able to walk 16 kilometers before being rescued.

sections.heading: Survival Instinct
paragraphs: Le Parisien reports that the hiker, an off-duty nurse, fell forward onto his trekking pole, which impaled him. His survival instinct reportedly took over, enabling him to walk the considerable distance to seek help.

sections.heading: Rescue and Recovery
paragraphs: parimatch.com mentions that after the hiker's fall, he continued walking while being impaled by his trekking pole. He was eventually rescued and received medical attention for his injuries.
